# ProgressBar

Header: `winui/ui/status/ProgressBar.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/status/ProgressBar.hpp`.

A thin horizontal bar showing determinate progress, or an endless sweep while the duration is unknown.

Determinate, the indicator covers the fraction of [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)] that [`value()`](#value) has reached and jumps to each new value without animating. Indeterminate, it sweeps across in a loop. [`show_paused()`](#show_paused) / [`show_error()`](#show_error) tint the indicator in the caution / critical color (error wins) and freeze an indeterminate sweep into one full-width bar. The bar is 200 DIPs wide unless its slot is narrower, and as tall as the theme draws it. It takes no input and has no disabled state.

[`ui::ProgressBar`](#uiprogressbar) is the declarative form.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<double> progress{0.0};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::ProgressBar{.value = progress, .width = 200.0f,
                               .accessibility = {.name = "Download progress"}},
        ui::ProgressBar{.width = 200.0f},
        ui::Button{.text = "Step", .on_click = [&] { progress += 10.0; }},
    },
});

// Imperatively:
auto bar = std::make_unique<ui::ProgressBarControl>(/*value=*/0.0, /*min=*/0.0, /*max=*/1.0);
bar->on_value_changed([](double v) { /* v is already clamped to [0, 1] */ });
bar->set_value(0.25);
bar->set_show_paused(true); // amber indicator
```

## `ui::ProgressBar`

A determinate or indeterminate horizontal progress bar. Builds a [ui::ProgressBarControl](#uiprogressbarcontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<double> progress{0.0};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::ProgressBar{.value = progress, .width = 200.0f},
        ui::ProgressBar{.width = 200.0f}, // no value: an indeterminate sweep
        ui::Button{.text = "Step", .on_click = [&] { progress += 10.0; }},
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::ProgressBar{
    .value, .min, .max, .show_paused, .show_error, .style, .margin, .width, .height,
    .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility, .on_value_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-value"></span>`value` | `ui::Binding<std::optional<double>>` |  | Value, clamped to [[`min`](#uiprogressbar-min), [`max`](#uiprogressbar-max)]; the filled share of the bar. Unset (the default) is an endless sweep, for work whose length is unknown. |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-min"></span>`min` | `ui::Binding<double>` | `{0.0}` | The value of the empty bar. |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-max"></span>`max` | `ui::Binding<double>` | `{100.0}` | The value of the full bar. Below [`min`](#uiprogressbar-min), it is taken as [`min`](#uiprogressbar-min). |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-show_paused"></span>`show_paused` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{false}` | The indicator in the caution color, and an indeterminate sweep frozen into a full bar. |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-show_error"></span>`show_error` | `ui::Binding<bool>` | `{false}` | As [`show_paused`](#uiprogressbar-show_paused), in the critical color. |
| <span id="uiprogressbar-on_value_changed"></span>`on_value_changed` | `ui::Callback<void(double)>` |  | The new (clamped) value, whenever a bound [`value`](#uiprogressbar-value) moves it. |

## `ui::ProgressBarControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::RangeValueProvider`.

A thin horizontal bar showing determinate progress, or an endless sweep while the duration is unknown.

Determinate, the indicator covers the fraction of [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)] that [`value()`](#value) has reached and jumps to each new value without animating. The bar is 200 DIPs wide unless its slot is narrower, and as tall as the theme draws it. It takes no input and has no disabled state.

[`ui::ProgressBar`](#uiprogressbar) is the declarative form.

```cpp

// Imperatively:
```

### ProgressBarControl

```cpp
ProgressBarControl(double value = 0.0, double min = 0.0, double max = 100.0)
```

A determinate bar; [`max`](#max) below [`min`](#min) is raised to [`min`](#min), and [`value`](#value) is clamped into the range.

### min

```cpp
double min() const
```

The value at which the bar is empty; 0 by default.

### max

```cpp
double max() const
```

The value at which the bar is full; 100 by default.

### set_range

```cpp
void set_range(double min, double max)
```

Sets both ends ([`max`](#max) below [`min`](#min) becomes [`min`](#min)) and re-clamps [`value()`](#value), firing [`on_value_changed()`](#on_value_changed) if that moves it. Always marks the bar for redraw.

### value

```cpp
double value() const
```

The value, always within [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)]; 0 by default. Ignored while indeterminate.

### set_value

```cpp
void set_value(double value)
```

Clamps into the range (to [`min()`](#min) for an empty range). Does nothing, and fires no callback, when the clamped value is unchanged. Otherwise redraws and fires [`on_value_changed()`](#on_value_changed).

### is_indeterminate

```cpp
bool is_indeterminate() const
```

Whether it shows an endless sweep instead of a filled share; false by default.

### set_indeterminate

```cpp
void set_indeterminate(bool indeterminate)
```

Redraws only. Turning the sweep on always restarts its phase from the beginning.

### show_paused

```cpp
bool show_paused() const
```

The indicator in the caution color; false by default.

### set_show_paused

```cpp
void set_show_paused(bool show_paused)
```

Marks the bar for redraw.

### show_error

```cpp
bool show_error() const
```

The indicator in the critical color, winning over [`show_paused()`](#show_paused); false by default.

### set_show_error

```cpp
void set_show_error(bool show_error)
```

Marks the bar for redraw.

### on_value_changed

```cpp
void on_value_changed(Callback<void(double)> handler)
```

Fired with the new, clamped value whenever [`value()`](#value) changes. Replaces any previous handler.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring reads nothing shared.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

[ProgressBar](#uiprogressbar), with a range value that UI Automation can read but not set, since the bar takes no input.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

200 DIPs wide and the theme's bar height tall, the width capped at a bounded `available` width.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the track, then the determinate indicator or the two clipped sweep bars.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances the theme's progress animation: the indeterminate sweep while neither paused nor in error, and a glint over the filled part in themes that draw one.
